_comment: EdgeSlicer's own error-code descriptions, consulted BEFORE Bambu's tables.
This exists because Bambu's published tables carry an empty `intro` for some codes that their
own slicer nevertheless shows a sentence for. Refreshing the snapshot cannot fix those; the
text has to be captured and recorded here.
Lookup order: <datadir>/hms/overrides.json (this user's own), then this file, then Bambu's
hms_<lang>_<model>.json tables, then the generic 'see the printer screen' fallback.
Within a file: exact language, then 'en', then any language present.
code   (required) the error code, 8 hex digits for a print_error or 16 for an HMS code.
Spaces are ignored, case is ignored.
model  (optional) the first three characters of the serial - 31B is the H2C, 094 the H2D,
20P the P1 line. '*' or omitted means every model.
lang   (optional) language code as the tables spell it ('en', 'de', 'zh-cn'). Default 'en'.
text   (required) what the user is shown.
source (optional) where the text came from, so a later reader can judge it.
date   (optional) when it was captured, ISO 8601.
note   (optional) anything uncertain about the entry. Recorded, never shown.
Add entries with `--hms-add`, through the hub's POST /hub/hms/override, or by hand; see
docs/hms-overrides.md. Contributions to this shipped file are welcome by PR.

overrides.text: Nozzle Camera is malfunctioning. If this issue occurs multiple times during printing, please contact customer support.
overrides.source: Bambu Studio UI, observed for this same event
overrides.note: Bambu's tables publish this text under 0C00010000020014 and carry an empty entry for ...0015, in every shipped language and in the live cloud table. Bambu Studio showed this sentence for a printer reporting ...0015, so the two codes appear to share a description upstream. Showing it is far more useful than showing the bare code, but the mapping is inferred, not published.
